name: Repairing Channel (Channeling)
body:
Your magic affects artificial structures as well as it does life forms.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy class feature

Benefit(s): When you channel energy to heal or harm living or undead creatures, you may instead choose to heal or harm constructs and unattended objects within range.
